{{Quote|From the Battles of Rashfond, to the Peacekeeping of Parliock, to our very own Clone Wars, the lightsaber is a Jedi's only true ally. But how do they work? Hmm? Yes, you have brought me crystals, but they're all useless unless you give them ''life''. Do you know how to awaken the Force within the crystal? No? Then I suggest you listen and learn, until you think of a question this droid ''cannot'' answer.|Huyang, to a class of Jedi Initiates|<ref name="A Test of Strength" />}}
[[Professor/Legends|Professor]] '''Huyang''' was a [[Gender/Legends|masculine]]-programmed [[Architect droid/Legends|architect droid]] who guided the [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiates]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in the construction of their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. Based aboard the [[Jedi training cruiser/Legends|Jedi training cruiser]] [[Crucible/Legends|''Crucible'']], Huyang began his service to the Order in its early [[Standard day/Legends|days]]. His instruction would commence once a class of [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] had passed [[Gathering/Legends|The Gathering]] on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] and collected their [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]]. Although criticized for being a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] despite his central role in [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]], he carried out his tasks with distinction, educating each new generation of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and providing them with the needed components from his vast cache of supplies. He also maintained an archive of each and every lightsaber, and its owner, within his [[Memory bank/Legends|memory bank]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], thousands of generations of Jedi had passed through Huyang's tutelage and completed their lightsabers.

In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Huyang's instruction of one particular class of Initiates&mdash;[[Petro/Legends|Petro]], [[Ganodi/Legends|Ganodi]], [[Byph/Legends|Byph]], [[Katooni/Legends|Katooni]], [[Zatt/Legends|Zatt]], and [[Gungi/Legends|Gungi]]&mdash;took an unexpected turn when a [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|gang]] of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] [[Raid on the Crucible/Legends|attacked and boarded]] the ''Crucible''. Although Huyang and his students repelled the brigands from the ''Crucible'', the Initiates' chaperone, [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], was captured. Huyang himself was almost completely [[Dismemberment/Legends|dismembered]] in combat, though he received repairs thanks to Ganodi, Zatt, and the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. While mounting an [[Rescue on Florrum/Legends|attempt]] to rescue Tano on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]], Huyang and the younglings were drawn into an all-out [[Invasion of Florrum/Legends|invasion]] launched by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], though with the aid of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] and his pirates, they evaded Grievous and safely returned to the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic fleet]].

==Biography==
===Teacher of Jedi Initiates===
[[File:Huyang-TCWs5BR1.png|thumb|left|180px|Professor Huyang]]
{{Quote|These are them? I swear, they get younger every expedition&hellip;|Huyang|<ref name="A Test of Strength" />}}
An [[Architect droid/Legends|architect droid]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Huyang&mdash;also [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] Huyang<ref name="A Test of Strength" /> or Master Huyang, as he came to be known<ref name="Bound for Rescue">{{TCW|Bound for Rescue}}</ref>&mdash;began his service to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] within its nascent [[Standard day/Legends|days]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> The Order was founded around [[25,783 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline 17">[[Timeline 17: The Jedi Order is Established]]</ref> from the ancient society known as the [[Je'daii Order]].<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi 0">[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0|''Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi'' 0]]</ref> Huyang served aboard the [[Jedi training cruiser/Legends|Jedi training vessel]] the [[Crucible/Legends|''Crucible'']].<ref name="A Test of Strength" />

As the sole being assigned to the ''Crucible'', Huyang maintained his own database of [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] designs and their designers, spanning the entire tenure of his considerable teaching career. It was aboard the ''Crucible'' that Huyang taught countless Jedi the means of constructing their own lightsabers in the last thousand years of their order.<ref name="A Test of Strength" /> Sometime during this period, he assisted then-Initiate [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] in the construction of his first lightsaber.<ref name="A Necessary Bond">{{TCW|A Necessary Bond}}</ref><ref name="Galaxy9">{{GalaxyCite|9|Design An Alien}}</ref>

===The Clone Wars===
====Training gone astray====
{{Quote|With this lightsaber, I'm going to challenge Obi-Wan Kenobi to a duel and kill Grievous!''"<br />"''The only person you are going to kill with ''that'', my young friend, is ''yourself''. You have inverted the emitter matrix, which will cause the power grid to backfire! Light this, and all that will be left of you and your lightsaber will be your crystal. Start again, and this time, ''please'' follow the diagram!|Petro and Huyang|<ref name="A Test of Strength" />}}
During the Clone Wars, a group of Initiates consisting of [[Byph/Legends|Byph]], [[Ganodi/Legends|Ganodi]], [[Gungi/Legends|Gungi]], [[Katooni/Legends|Katooni]], [[Petro/Legends|Petro]], and [[Zatt/Legends|Zatt]]&mdash;having recently completed [[Gathering (20 BBY)/Legends|their]] [[Gathering/Legends|Gathering trial]]&mdash;arrived on the ''Crucible'' to be instructed by Huyang in the construction of their lightsabers.<ref name="A Test of Strength" /><ref name="The Gathering">{{TCW|The Gathering (episode)}}</ref>

Some of the Initiates, Ganodi in particular, were skeptical of the droid due to his extreme age, but were quickly won over by his wisdom and anecdotes from the annals of Jedi history. Patiently, Huyang guided the Initiates in the construction and personalization of their respective blades.<ref name="A Test of Strength" />

Before the younglings could complete their task, Huyang's vessel was [[Raid on the Crucible/Legends|assaulted]] by [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] and [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|his pirate gang]], who were intent on stealing any [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]] aboard due to their high market value. To safeguard the Initiates' unique crystals, Huyang gathered and stored them inside his chest. Unbeknownst to him at the time, however, Petro had surreptitiously palmed his crystal and handed Huyang a droid component.<ref name="A Test of Strength" />

Huyang, [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Tano]], and the group of Initiates chose to hide in the ship's ventilation system when the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] boarded the ''Crucible'' and began searching for their prize. In executing a plan of Tano's devising, Huyang and the younglings were found and caught by a group of pirates, but Petro put his crystal into his poorly crafted lightsaber and tricked the largest pirate into activating it, causing it to explode, knocking the pirates unconscious and damaging Huyang in the process.<ref name="A Test of Strength" />

[[File:HeadlessHuyangKickingWeequay-ATOS.png|thumb|right|250px|Huyang defeating a pirate even lacking his head and primary arms]]Eventually, Huyang and the younglings were confronted by Ohnaka and more pirates before Tano arrived and subdued the pirates with a [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Push|Force Push]]. As Tano began to hold Ohnaka off, Huyang began to lead the Initiates to safety, but ending up having his head shot off by one of the pirates. The droid professor then engaged the pirate in unarmed combat and managed to defeat him, despite having both his arms blasted off as well. The Initiates then collected his body parts and took shelter in the ''Crucible''{{'s}} hold. Unfortunately for Tano, the plan to liberate the ship did not go exactly as planned, and she was captured by the pirates even as she drove them from the ship.<ref name="A Test of Strength" />

====Misadventures on Florrum====
{{Quote|If I may, sir, I have instructed younglings for over a thousand generations, and these are among the best I have ever seen.|Huyang, to Hondo Ohnaka|<ref name="A Necessary Bond" />}}
Still significantly damaged from his battle with Hondo Ohnaka, Huyang was able to offer little in the way of assistance when the group of Initiates decided to pursue the pirates back to [[Hondo's complex/Legends|their base]] on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] in order to [[Rescue on Florrum/Legends|rescue]] Padawan Tano. With the ''Crucible'' landed on the planet surface to effect repairs, Huyang remained aboard with Initiate Ganodi and fellow droid [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], while the remaining Initiates set out to rescue Tano.<ref name="Bound for Rescue" />

With the others gone, Ganodi began to repair Huyang, beginning with re-attaching his head to his body. He had only just completed this task when the other Initiates&mdash;having managed to rescue Tano from the pirates&mdash;made contact to ask for help in escaping their pirate pursuers.<ref name="A Necessary Bond" />

Huyang, the young [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] Initiate, and R2-D2 immediately launched the ''Crucible'' and flew to rescue their companions. The effort was a near-success, almost managing to secure the Jedi, until one of the pirates scored a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] hit on one of the ship's [[Engine/Legends|engines]], causing the ancient Jedi vessel to crash and the entire group to be recaptured by the pirates.<ref name="A Necessary Bond" />

As the captors and captives began making their way back to the pirate outpost, they stumbled upon something unexpected: [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] and an army of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] had landed and claimed the [[Florrum system/Legends|system]] for the Confederacy.<ref name="A Necessary Bond" />

Faced with no alternative, the pirates chose to release their Jedi captives in order to work together to rescue Ohnaka so that they could ''all'' escape the planet. The combined group achieved their goal without taking any casualties, and together escaped back to a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] fleet commanded by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Huyang was finally repaired once they found themselves back in friendly territory.<ref name="A Necessary Bond" />

==Characteristics==
===Features and equipment===
{{Quote|Many years I have been on this ship teaching many a Jedi before you, and I will continue teaching many a Jedi ''after'' you. Call me what you want, but inside my memory banks I contain a record of every lightsaber ever made, and the Jedi who fashioned them.|Huyang, to Ganodi|<ref name="A Test of Strength" />}}
[[File:HuyangMultitasking-ATOS.png|thumb|250px|Huyang using his multiple arms to search several drawers at once|left]]

===Personality===
{{Quote|It's not finished. I never finished it. I've done everything right, but it won't work!''"<br />"''You must trust that the components that form your lightsaber are ''meant'' to be together. There is no other way. It is the ''Force'' that binds them.|Katooni is guided by Huyang in assembling her lightsaber|<ref name="A Necessary Bond" />}}
Huyang was many millennia old during the Clone Wars, having instructed Jedi in their training for over a thousand generations.<ref name="A Necessary Bond" /> Befitting his age, Huyang had developed a personality possessed of great knowledge and wisdom, paired with quirks such as a dry sense of humor and indignant responses when his usefulness was questioned due to his age.<ref name="A Test of Strength" />

==Behind the scenes==
Huyang was voiced in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' by actor [[David Tennant]], best known as the [[Wikipedia:Tenth Doctor|Tenth Doctor]] in long-running science-fiction series [[Wikipedia:Doctor Who|''Doctor Who'']]. He won an Emmy for his portrayal of Huyang.<ref name="Emmy">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-wins-two-daytime-emmy-awards|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Wins Two Daytime Emmy Awards}}</ref>
